Resolved: replaced with honest 'дистанция до нижнечелюстного канала не измерялась (—)' and 'Канал IAN: не измерялся (—)'.

BUG-IAN-02: When nerve clearance was below 1.5 mm (critical danger), Form 043/u previously printed '(норма безопасности соблюдена)'. Resolved: wired 3-tier status strings (<1.5 mm RED ALERT, 1.5..2.0 mm YELLOW WARNING, >=2.0 mm GREEN SAFE).

CYLINDER-BUFFER-01: Proximity of virtual implant body to nerve must account for implant radius (diameter/2) along the entire cylindrical body, not just the apex point. A vertical implant with apex 5 mm from canal center has only 1.6 mm body clearance (5 - 1.4 - 2.0 = 1.6 mm), which correctly triggers the Misch CE warning buffer (< 2.0 mm).

MISCH-TORQUE-01: D1/D2 requires 35-45 N*cm and copious 4°C irrigation with under-drilling prohibited to prevent thermal necrosis. D4 requires 25-35 N*cm with bone condensation protocol (osteotomes) and under-drilling to ensure primary stability.
